milestone_synthesis_summary: 2026.05.261 landed 11 of 13 task artifacts. Wins: (1) Phase 4 FEP redesign (strategy2 learned-logistic) lifted FEP-AUROC from 0.54 to 0.99, restoring verifier-as-alpha_t hypothesis empirically — though adversarial-flagged for TAUTOLOGY and needs cross-validation. (2) Ensemble v12 integrated 3 new verifiers (Tier 0g/0v/0w) producing k=18 ensemble with +0.011 AUROC lift; Tier 0w shows promising decorrelation (0.26). (3) Routing architecture improved on both axes — conformal router gets 84% savings WITH anytime-valid guarantee, weak-strong threshold-orientation bug fixed (41% savings, 0% FNR). (4) FR-11 Tier 4 learning loop revalidated with pool/test overlap=0 and cycle-3 AUROC 0.9275 — generalization confirmed, not memorization. (5) Tier 0y differentiable conformal calibration shipped (ECE ~5e-8). (6) Paper-v6 main.tex updated and recompiled (28 pages); arXiv package v3 ready and HOLDS for operator review. (7) Phase 1 ship confirmed at tag v0.1.0b1. Gaps: (A) exp2752 verifier_live_gpu_v3 absent — 3rd consecutive attempt missing a non-adversarial live-GPU verifier transcript. (B) empirical_delta_diagnostic=0.0 means paper-v6 4/delta cite is BLOCKED. (C) FEP TAUTOLOGY flag needs held-out adversarial recheck before paper-v6 can claim Phase 4 empirical validation.
